blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Аннотация In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification.
An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator.
We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk , a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component.
Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to + 0.19 +0.19 PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Open-set recognition (OSR) is the standard formulation for recognition systems deployed in open-world environments: the system must both identify samples from known classes and reject samples from unknown classes.
This setting appears in face recognition, speaker identification, whale and dolphin identification, authorship attribution, intent classification, and topic recognition [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
A standard OSR pipeline compares the probe embedding to the gallery prototypes by cosine similarity: the probe is accepted if the best similarity exceeds a threshold and is then assigned the identity of the closest prototype; otherwise it is rejected as unknown.
With modern metric-learning losses such as ArcFace and CosFace, this paradigm achieves high recognition accuracy [ 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
开放设置识别(OSR)是在开放世界环境中部署的识别系统的标准配方:系统既必须识别已知类的样本,又必须拒绝未知类的样本.
这种背景表现在承认、演讲者识别、鲸鱼和海豚识别、作者归属、意图分类和专题识别[1、2、3、4、5、6]。
一个标准的OSR管道通过余弦相似性将探测器嵌入物与画廊原型进行对比:如果最佳相似性超过一个阈值,则接受探测器,然后被分配到最接近原型的身份;否则就被拒绝为未知.
随着ArcFace和CosFace等现代的计量学习损失,这个范式实现了高识别精度[7,8].

blocks.en:
High accuracy alone is not sufficient in risk-sensitive applications.
The system must also estimate the reliability of each decision, so that unreliable decisions can be deferred to a human operator or resolved by acquiring another sample.
This is the selective-recognition setting, where an uncertainty score is evaluated by how well it ranks erroneous decisions ahead of correct ones [ 9 , 10 ] .
In OSR the ranking task is non-trivial because three qualitatively different errors coexist: 1. False acceptance (FA): an unknown probe is accepted as a known gallery class. 2. False rejection (FR): a known probe is rejected as unknown. 3. Misidentification (ID): a known probe is accepted but assigned the wrong identity.
blocks.zh:
单靠高精度不足以进行对风险敏感的应用。
该系统还必须估计每项决定的可靠性,以便不可靠的决定可以推迟到人类操作者作出,或者通过获取另一个样本来解决.
这就是有选择的承认设定,在这种设定中,不确定性的得分通过它在多大程度上将错误的决定排在正确决定之前来评估[9、10]。
在OSR中,排名任务是非三角性的,因为三个质量不同的错误并存: 1. 虚假接受(FA):未知探测器被接受为已知的画廊类. 2. 虚假拒绝(FR):已知的探测器作为未知拒绝。 3. 误认(ID):接受已知的探测器,但分配错误的身份。

blocks.en: False acceptance (FA): an unknown probe is accepted as a known gallery class.
blocks.zh: 虚假接受(FA):未知探测器被接受为已知的画廊类.

blocks.en: False rejection (FR): a known probe is rejected as unknown.
blocks.zh: 假拒绝(FR):已知的探测器被拒绝为未知.

blocks.en: Misidentification (ID): a known probe is accepted but assigned the wrong identity.
blocks.zh: 误认(ID):一个已知的探测器被接受,但被指定了错误的身份.

blocks.en:
Gallery-aware Bayesian models address this multiplicity by reconstructing a posterior distribution over known and unknown classes.
Probabilistic embeddings such as PFE and SCF capture sample-quality ambiguity [ 11 , 12 ] ; gallery-aware models additionally use the relative position of the probe and the gallery prototypes [ 13 ] .
Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) combines both sources: it summarizes the posterior by two Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence components and maps them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator trained on validation data.
blocks.zh:
Gallery-aware Bayesian的模型通过在已知和未知的类别上重建后期分布来解决这种多重性.
概率嵌入物如PFE和SCF捕获样品质量的模糊性[11,12];画廊感知模型额外使用探测器和画廊原型的相对位置[13].
整体不确定性估计(HolUE)结合了两种来源:它用两个Kullback-Leibler(KL)的偏差元件来总结后序,用一个经过验证数据培训的受监督的非线性计算器将其映射到一个不确定性分数.

blocks.en:
The starting point of this paper is a general question: are information-gain summaries appropriate for ranking the risk of an OSR decision? KL divergence measures how far the posterior moved from the prior, whereas selective recognition requires a score aligned with the probability or cost of the actual decision error.
These two orderings can disagree: a posterior split between two plausible gallery identities is far from a uniform prior, yet the maximum-posterior decision carries high risk.
Section 3.4 makes this mismatch precise, and Section 5.6 confirms it empirically: linear fusion of the HolUE KL components, tuned on validation data, produces negative filtering quality on several benchmarks, while the same features perform well under HolUE’s nonlinear calibration.
blocks.zh:
本文的出发点是一个一般性问题:信息获取摘要是否适合于对经营社会责任决定的风险进行排名? KL 差异度测量后方与前方的距离,而选择性识别则需要与实际判断错误的概率或成本一致的分数.
这两项命令可能会有分歧:在两个貌似可行的画廊身份之间划分后,远非统一前置,但最大前置决定的风险很大。
第3.4节使这种不匹配是准确的,第5.6节从经验上证实了这一点:根据验证数据对HolUE KL组件进行线性聚变,在几个基准上产生负过滤质量,而同一特性在HolUE的非线性校准下表现良好.

blocks.en:
We propose MPRisk , a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that avoids the need for nonlinear calibration by scoring the error events of the selected decision directly.
MPRisk reuses the Bayesian posterior over known and unknown classes and combines four components: false-acceptance risk r FA r_{\mathrm{FA}} , misidentification risk r ID r_{\mathrm{ID}} , false-rejection risk r FR r_{\mathrm{FR}} , and a reject non-specificity penalty r NS r_{\mathrm{NS}} .
The last component exists only because the unknown part of the class space is modeled as a continuous component representing unknown identities: it asks whether a rejection is supported by a specific unknown-identity hypothesis or merely by diffuse evidence, and thereby detects poor-quality in-gallery probes that are confidently but wrongly rejected.
The ranking score contains no nonlinear fitted model; four nonnegative weights are selected on validation data, and an optional monotone calibration step converts the score into an error-probability estimate for reliability analysis.
Figure 1 summarizes the approach.

blocks.en: We make three contributions: • Analysis. We show that KL-based summaries of the gallery-aware posterior are not generally ordered by the risk of the selected OSR decision, and that linear fusion of the HolUE KL features performs poorly on several benchmarks while nonlinear calibration recovers useful rankings. • Method. We derive MPRisk, which combines posterior terms for false acceptance, misidentification, and false rejection with a closed-form non-specificity penalty for rejected probes based on the continuous unknown component of the mixed prior. • Evaluation. Under matched validation budgets we compare MPRisk with KL-based, post-hoc, and supervised scores on nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, including component ablations, error-type analysis, calibration diagnostics, and runtime measurements.

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Open-set recognition and open-world learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 开放设置识别与开放世界学习.

blocks.en:
Open-set recognition was introduced to describe recognition systems that must handle classes absent from training or enrollment [ 1 ] .
The broader open-world learning literature studies unknown-class rejection, open-set classification, and incremental discovery of new classes [ 14 , 15 ] .
Deep open-set methods such as OpenMax and DOC modify the classifier head or activation statistics to reduce open-space risk [ 16 , 17 ] ; a further line of work improves the discriminative separation of known and unknown classes with specialized losses and architectures [ 14 ] .
Most of this literature improves recognition or unknown-detection accuracy, whereas we estimate the reliability of decisions of a fixed OSR system without changing the embedding model, gallery, or acceptance rule.
blocks.zh:
采用了开放设定的识别,以描述必须处理未参加培训或未入学课程的识别系统[1]。
更广泛的开放世界学习文献研究未知阶级排斥,开放设置分类,逐步发现新阶级[14,15].
OpenMax和DOC等深层开放设置方法修改分类器头或激活统计以减少开放空间风险[16,17];另一条工作线则改善了已知和未知类的区分,具有专门损失和架构[14].
这些文献大多改进了识别或未知检测的准确性,而我们则在不改变嵌入模型,画廊,或接受规则的情况下估计固定的OSR系统决定的可靠性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Open-set recognition in text
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 文本中的开放设置识别

blocks.en:
Several text tasks naturally follow the OSR protocol.
In intent classification a conversational system must reject out-of-scope requests; CLINC150 is the standard benchmark [ 5 ] .
Topic classification datasets such as Yahoo Answers, AGNews, and DBPedia are converted into open-set protocols by treating a subset of topics as known [ 6 , 18 ] .
Authorship attribution and verification are inherently open-set [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] ; PAN protocols provide challenging settings with dynamic galleries [ 22 , 23 ] .
Our previous work adapted gallery-aware KL-based uncertainty estimation to open-set text classification; here we use both modality groups within the identical Bayesian model.
blocks.zh:
几个文本任务自然遵循 OSR 协议.
在意图分类中,谈话系统必须拒绝范围外的请求;CLINC150是标准基准[5].
主题分类数据集如Yahoo Answers,AGNews,和DBPedia通过将一个子集的话题称为知 [6,18] 转换成开放设置的协议.
授权归属和核查本质上是开放设置 [19, 20, 21] ; PAN 协议以动态画廊提供具有挑战性的设置 [22, 23].
我们先前的工作调整了基于画廊-认识KL的不确定性估计,以进行开放式文本分类;在这里,我们使用相同的贝叶斯模型中的两种模式组。

blocks.en: 2.3 Aleatoric uncertainty and probabilistic embeddings
blocks.zh: 2.3 预测不确定性和概率嵌入

blocks.en:
Uncertainty in deep learning is commonly decomposed into epistemic and aleatoric components [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] ; in our fixed-backbone, fixed-gallery pipeline the dominant source is aleatoric, arising from the relation between a probe and the gallery.
Probabilistic embeddings represent this uncertainty directly: PFE predicts feature uncertainty in Euclidean space [ 11 ] , and the SCF model predicts a von Mises–Fisher (vMF) distribution on the unit hypersphere [ 12 ] , p ⁡ ( 𝐳 | 𝐱 ) = C d ​ ( κ 𝐱 ) ​ exp ⁡ ( κ 𝐱 ​ 𝝁 𝐱 ⊤ ​ 𝐳 ) , p(\mathbf{z}|\mathbf{x})=C_{d}(\kappa_{\mathbf{x}})\exp(\kappa_{\mathbf{x}}\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\mathbf{x}}^{\top}\mathbf{z}), where 𝝁 𝐱 \boldsymbol{\mu}_{\mathbf{x}} is a unit mean direction and κ 𝐱 \kappa_{\mathbf{x}} a concentration [ 28 ] ; large κ 𝐱 \kappa_{\mathbf{x}} corresponds to a high-quality embedding.
MPRisk uses this vMF distribution twice: to average the embedding-conditioned posterior into probe-level class probabilities and to obtain a closed-form non-specificity of the unknown-identity posterior (Section 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 2.4 Selective prediction and calibration
blocks.zh: 2.4 选择性预测和校准

blocks.en:
Selective prediction evaluates whether uncertain samples are rejected before confident ones [ 9 , 10 ] .
Classical decision theory prescribes rejecting when the conditional risk of the best action exceeds the rejection cost (Chow’s rule); under 0–1 loss the optimal score is the posterior error probability 1 − max a ⁡ p ⁡ ( a | 𝐱 ) 1-\max_{a}p(a|\mathbf{x}) , not an entropy- or divergence-based functional.
MPRisk instantiates this principle for the OSR action space, where the loss structure differs across accept and reject decisions.
Calibration, in contrast, concerns whether predicted probabilities match empirical frequencies [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] ; we treat ranking (evaluated by the Prediction Rejection Ratio [ 32 ] ) and probability calibration (evaluated by ECE) as separate goals.
blocks.zh:
选择性预测评价不确定样本是否在自信样本之前被拒绝[9,10].
古典裁决理论规定,当有条件的最佳行动风险超过拒绝成本(Chow's rule)时拒绝;在0–1损失下,最佳得分是后误差概率 1–最大 a ⁡ p ⁡ (a x xa) 1-\max_{a}p(a|\s|\mathbf{x}),而不是一个基于py或歧义的函数.
MPRisk将这一原则即时化为OSR动作空间,其中损失结构因接受和拒绝决定而异.
与此相反,校准对预测概率是否符合经验频率[29、30、31];我们把排名(由预测拒绝比率[32]评价)和概率校准(由欧洲经委会评价)作为单独的目标。

blocks.en: 2.5 Relation to prior work
blocks.zh: 2.5 与先前工作的关系

blocks.en:
We are not aware of prior work that decomposes OSR uncertainty into decision-conditioned posterior risks while retaining a continuous unknown-identity component.
Existing gallery-aware estimators use raw posterior confidence [ 13 ] or information-theoretic summaries with supervised calibration; existing selective-prediction scores operate on logits or sample quality and ignore the accept/reject decision structure.

HolUE does not use these components directly: it normalizes them on a validation set and fuses them with a supervised nonlinear calibrator trained on validation error labels — an exponential-transform model in the biometric setting and a small MLP in the text setting.

blocks.en:
Why is the nonlinear step needed?
For a uniform prior over N N outcomes, D KL ( p ∥ p unif ) = log N − H ( p ) , D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|p_{\mathrm{unif}})=\log N-H(p), so the KL summary ranks probes by negative posterior entropy, whereas the decision risk of the maximum-posterior action is R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) = 1 − max a ⁡ p ⁡ ( a | 𝐱 ) . R(\mathbf{x})=1-\max_{a}p(a|\mathbf{x}). For N ≥ 3 N\geq 3 , entropy and maximum probability are not monotone functions of each other: a posterior split between two identities — the misidentification-prone case — is under-penalized by an entropy-type score relative to a mildly diffuse posterior.
Two further mismatches are specific to OSR.
First, KL aggregates evidence about all actions, whereas risk concerns only the action taken: a rejected probe with a sharp two-way split among gallery classes carries large KL 1 \mathrm{KL}_{1} that is irrelevant to the rejection’s correctness.
Second, KL 2 \mathrm{KL}_{2} grows with the concentration κ 𝐱 \kappa_{\mathbf{x}} , so its relation to error probability reverses between accepted and rejected probes.
A fixed monotone transformation of each component cannot in general account for this change of meaning across decision contexts; HolUE therefore learns a flexible nonlinear mapping on validation data.

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets, protocols, and baselines
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集、协议和基线

blocks.en:
We evaluate on four image and audio identification benchmarks — IJB-C [ 33 ] , IJB-B [ 34 ] , Whale [ 4 ] , and VoxBlink (VB-Eval-L-5) [ 3 ] — and five text benchmarks — Yahoo Answers, AGNews, DBPedia [ 6 ] , CLINC150 [ 5 ] , and PAN-20-AV [ 22 ] .
Backbones, galleries, thresholds, and OSR protocols follow our previous work exactly: ArcFace/SCF backbones for image and audio, the Whale OSR protocol built on HappyWhale, and frozen-BERT SCF heads with the gallery constructions of our previous work for text.
Recognition decisions are fixed throughout; methods are compared purely as uncertainty estimators.
Validation splits are disjoint from test in identities/authors/topics and are used for all weight tuning, supervised fitting, and calibration; every validation-consuming method receives the same validation data.
blocks.zh:
我们评价四个图像和音频识别基准——IJB-C[33],IJB-B[34],Whale[4],VoxBlink(VB-Eval-L-5)[3]——和五个文本基准——雅虎回答,AGNews,DBPedia[6],CLINC150[5],以及PAN-20-AV[22].
背骨 画廊 阈值 和 OSR 协议 完全跟随我们之前的作品:ArcFace/SCF 图像和音频主干线,基于HappyWhale的Whale OSR协议,以及冷冻-BERT SCF 头和我们之前的文字作品的画廊构造.
承认决定贯穿全局;方法纯粹被比作不确定性估计。
验证拆分与身份/作者/专题的测试脱节,用于所有重量调制、监督装配和校准;每个耗验证的方法都得到相同的验证数据。

blocks.en:
Baselines include SCF (sample quality), AccScr (distance to the rejection threshold), MSP and Margin (post-hoc confidence over gallery-augmented logits with calibrated temperature), GalUE (gallery ambiguity), and HolUE in its original validation-calibrated form (Section 3.4 ) [ 13 ] .
The prior mass is β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 everywhere; robustness of the shared posterior to β \beta was established previously and carries over to MPRisk.

blocks.en: 5.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 计量

blocks.en:
Our primary metric is the Prediction Rejection Ratio (PRR) [ 32 ] , computed from the F 1 F_{1} score as probes are removed in decreasing order of uncertainty: PRR = AUC unc − AUC random AUC oracle − AUC random , \mathrm{PRR}=\frac{\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{unc}}-\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{random}}}{\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{oracle}}-\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{random}}}, so that 1 1 corresponds to oracle filtering, 0 0 to random filtering, and negative values to a score worse than random.
We complement PRR with per-error-type detection AUROC (any error, FA, FR, ID), paired bootstrap confidence intervals for PRR differences (resampling over probes), expected calibration error (ECE) with reliability diagrams for the calibrated variants, and wall-clock per-probe runtime.

blocks.en:
Both HolUE and tuned MPRisk consume the same validation set, so the head-to-head comparison below is tuned-versus-tuned.
To isolate what the feature representation contributes beyond the shared validation access, we additionally evaluate a family of estimators built on the same posterior and validation data: • Linear KL fusion : the KL evidence restricted to a linear rule.
The features − KL 1 -\mathrm{KL}_{1} , − KL 2 -\mathrm{KL}_{2} , and − ( KL 1 + KL 2 ) -(\mathrm{KL}_{1}+\mathrm{KL}_{2}) are sign-expanded (each feature also enters negated, so arbitrary signed combinations are reachable), standardized on validation, and combined with weights selected by the same randomized PRR val F 1 \mathrm{PRR}^{F_{1}}_{\mathrm{val}} search used for λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} .
Comparing this row with HolUE isolates the contribution of the nonlinear calibrator; comparing it with tuned MPRisk isolates the contribution of the risk features under identical linear tuning. • Tuned simple : the same linear protocol applied to the post-hoc scores { \{ SCF, AccScr, MSP, Margin } \} . • Rejected-SCF : the SCF quality score gated by the rejection decision (accepted probes receive a constant low value), isolating the gating idea from the P 0 P_{0} weighting in r NS r_{\mathrm{NS}} . • Supervised logistic / Supervised MLP : error detectors trained on validation with binary any-error labels over a 14 14 -dimensional feature vector combining the four post-hoc scores with all posterior features ( − KL 1 -\mathrm{KL}_{1} , − KL 2 -\mathrm{KL}_{2} , their sum, P 0 P_{0} , 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} , the four MPRisk components, and the raw MPRisk sum).
The logistic model uses balanced class weights; the MLP is a single-hidden-layer network (16 units, weight decay, early stopping).
These are stronger supervised baselines with a larger feature set; note they differ from HolUE’s calibrator, which operates on only two normalized features with a task-specific objective. • Hybrid KL+MPRisk : a tuned linear combination of the Linear-KL-fusion score and the tuned MPRisk score, testing whether information gain and decision risk are complementary.

MPRisk is best or tied-best at all 12 reported operating points.
The gains grow with FPIR: at FPIR 0.2 0.2 MPRisk reaches 0.91 0.91 on IJB-C ( + 0.18 +0.18 over HolUE), 0.87 0.87 on IJB-B, and 0.94 0.94 on Whale ( + 0.11 +0.11 over HolUE) — higher FPIR admits more unknown probes, so the acceptance-conditioned risks carry more of the error mass.

blocks.en: Four conclusions follow.
blocks.zh: 以下四个结论。

blocks.en:
(i) Linear fusion is effective for MPRisk features but not for the KL features. Linear KL fusion produces negative PRR on IJB-C ( − 0.67 -0.67 / − 0.50 -0.50 ) and IJB-B ( − 1.31 -1.31 ) and trails elsewhere, whereas the same KL evidence fused by HolUE’s nonlinear calibrator reaches 0.76 0.76 / 0.81 0.81 on IJB-C (Table 2 ).
This is the analysis of Section 3.4 made quantitative.
MPRisk reaches 0.76 0.76 / 0.84 0.84 / 0.91 0.91 on IJB-C with four nonnegative weights: the risk decomposition yields features that combine effectively under a linear score.
blocks.zh:
(一)线性聚变对MPRisk特性有效,但对KL特性无效. 线性KL聚变在IJB-C(− 0.67-0.67 /− 0.50-0.50)和IJB-B(− 1.31-1.31)上产生负PRR,并在其他地方产生小径,而HolUE的非线性钙化物所熔化的同一KL证据在IJB-C上达到0.76 0.76 /0.81 0.81(表2)。
这是对第3.4节所作的定量分析。
MPRisk在IJB-C上达到0.76 0.76 / 0.84 0.84 / 0.91 0.91 / 4 非负重:风险分解特性在线性分数下有效结合.

blocks.en: (ii) Linear fusion of heterogeneous post-hoc scores generalizes poorly. Tuned simple is competitive on IJB-C and VoxBlink but substantially negative on IJB-B ( − 2.89 -2.89 ) and weak on DBPedia; scores on incompatible scales transfer poorly from validation to test even after standardization, whereas the MPRisk components share a common posterior-probability scale.
blocks.zh: (二) 不同分数的线性聚变一般差。 教学简便在IJB-C和VoxBlink上具有竞争力,但在IJB-B(−2.89-2.89)上却基本上为负数,在DBPedia上则很弱;在不兼容的尺度上的分数从验证到测试都差,即使在标准化后,MPRisk组件都具有共同的后置概率尺度.

blocks.en:
(iii) MPRisk is competitive with supervised detectors at much lower capacity. Supervised logistic — trained on error labels over the full 14 14 -dimensional feature set — exceeds tuned MPRisk only modestly (e.g., Whale 0.86 0.86 vs. 0.81 0.81 at FPIR 0.05 0.05 ; DBPedia 0.89 0.89 vs. 0.72 0.72 at FPIR 0.1 0.1 ) and loses at some points (VoxBlink at FPIR 0.1 0.1 ).
The supervised MLP varies substantially across datasets, from 0.88 0.88 on Yahoo to − 0.70 -0.70 on IJB-C and − 0.38 -0.38 on Whale; this does not contradict the stability of HolUE’s two-input, task-objective MLP — on moderate validation sets, performance tracks how tightly the hypothesis class matches the task rather than raw capacity.
blocks.zh:
(三) MPRisk与受监督的探测器竞争能力低得多。 监督后勤——在完整的14个14维特性集上接受错误标签培训——仅略微超过调制MPRisk(例如,Whale 0.86 0.86 vs.0.81 0.81 at FPIR 0.05;DBPedia 0.89 0.89 vs.0.72 at FPIR 0.1 ),在某些点上输(VoxBlink at FPIR 0.1 0.1)。
所监管的MLP在不同的数据集中差异很大,从Yahoo的0.88 0.88到IJB-C的0.70-0.70和Whale的0.38-0.38;这与HolUE的双输入、任务目标MLP的稳定性并不矛盾——在中度验证组上,性能跟踪假设类与任务比比比比比比比比比比比比。

blocks.en: (iv) Decision risk and information gain are complementary. Hybrid KL+MPRisk, a tuned combination of two scalars, obtains the highest PRR at 9 9 of 12 12 image/audio operating points and on AGNews and PAN-20-AV (e.g., 0.43 0.43 at PAN FPIR 0.1 0.1 , + 0.25 +0.25 over HolUE); on Yahoo it recovers most of HolUE’s advantage ( 0.73 0.73 vs. 0.77 0.77 ).

blocks.en:
Three facts emerge.
First, single components are not scores: each decision-conditioned component is identically zero on the complementary decision set, so in isolation it ranks half of the probes arbitrarily.
This is why r FA r_{\mathrm{FA}} alone reaches PRR − 3.54 -3.54 at low FPIR (where almost no unknown probes are accepted) yet 0.85 0.85 at high FPIR.
Second, which component dominates is dataset- and operating-point-specific: acceptance risks dominate DBPedia and high-FPIR points, while rejection components dominate Yahoo, CLINC150, and PAN at low FPIR ( r FR r_{\mathrm{FR}} alone achieves 0.66 0.66 on Yahoo).
No fixed weighting serves all regimes.
Third, the tuned combination is uniformly near the per-cell maximum over all variants, while the equal-cost combinations inherit the weaknesses of their dominant untuned term.
The addition of r NS r_{\mathrm{NS}} on top of the tuned three-component score gives small consistent gains at specific operating points ( + 0.01 +0.01 on IJB-C/IJB-B at FPIR 0.2 0.2 ; + 0.04 +0.04 / + 0.07 +0.07 on VoxBlink; + 0.03 +0.03 on DBPedia at FPIR 0.1 0.1 ; + 0.28 +0.28 on Yahoo at FPIR 0.3 0.3 ); its main value, shown in Sections 5.8 – 5.9 , is rejection-specific detection and interpretability.
blocks.zh:
现现三种事实.
首先,单个组件不是分数:每个有决定条件的组件在互补决定集上都是同样零的,因此孤立地将其任意排在探测器的一半.
这就是为什么r FA r_{\mathrm{FA}}单于在低FPIR(几乎没有接受未知探测器的地方)达到PRR - 3.54-3.54,而在高FPIR却达到0.85 0.85。
其次,哪个组件占主导地位是数据集和操作点:接受风险主导DBPedia和高FPIR点,而拒绝组件则主导雅虎,CLINC150和PAN在低FPIR(r FR r_{\mathrm{FR}}}}单在雅虎上达到0.66 0.66).
没有固定加权适用于所有制度。
第三,调谐组合在所有变种上统一接近每个细胞最大值,而等价组合继承了它们主导性未调谐术语的弱点.
r NS r_{\mathrm{NS}}在调制的三元分数上加注r r_{\mathrm{NS}},使特定操作点的一致收益很小(在FPIR 0.2的IJB-C/IJB-B上加0.01+0.01;在VoxBlink上加+0.04+0.07+0.07;在FPIR 0.1的DBPedia上加+0.03;在FPIR 0.3的Yahoo上加+0.28);其主要价值在第5.8–5.9节中显示,是拒绝的可检测性和可解释性。

blocks.en:
On the image and audio benchmarks, tuned MPRisk is the best overall error detector and the best FA and ID detector (IJB-C: FA 0.98 0.98 , ID 0.97 0.97 ; Whale: FA 0.96 0.96 , ID 0.94 0.94 ), at a moderate cost in FR AUROC relative to threshold-based scores.
On Yahoo Answers, where errors are almost entirely false rejections, optimization for aggregate PRR pushes MPRisk’s weights toward r FR r_{\mathrm{FR}} / r NS r_{\mathrm{NS}} : its FR AUROC reaches 0.90 0.90 , close to HolUE’s 0.92 0.92 , while its FA AUROC drops to 0.20 0.20 because the objective assigns little weight to the rare FA errors.
On PAN-20-AV, MPRisk is the best any-error and FR detector ( 0.68 0.68 and 0.66 0.66 ) while conceding FA and ID to gallery scores; MPRisk raw is the best ID detector there ( 0.91 0.91 ).
These trade-offs stem from compressing four costs into one scalar for one metric, not from the decomposition itself: a deployment with asymmetric error costs can tune λ \lambda against its own cost matrix, which single-summary scores do not support.

blocks.en: 6 DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 6 讨论

blocks.en:
HolUE and MPRisk use the same posterior and validation split; they differ in the features and the final scoring model.
The KL components contain useful information, but their ordering is not generally consistent with decision risk, so their usefulness depends on the learned nonlinear calibration: the same features under linear tuning produce negative PRR on several benchmarks.
The decision-conditioned components, in contrast, combine effectively under a four-weight linear rule, generalize stably from validation to test, and outperform the calibrated KL score at 25 of 27 image/audio operating points and on most text operating points.
Overall: gains whose bootstrap intervals exclude zero on five of nine benchmarks, ties or inconclusive differences on three, and one clear HolUE win (Yahoo Answers).
blocks.zh:
HolUE和MPRisk使用相同的后置和验证分裂;在特征和最终评分模型上有所不同.
KL组件包含有用的信息,但其顺序一般与决策风险不一致,因此其用途取决于所学的非线性校准:线性调制下的相同特性在多个基准上产生负PRR.
相形之下,决定条件的组件在四重线性规则下有效结合,从验证到测试均稳定地概括,在27个图像/音频操作点的25个和大多数文本操作点上,标定的KL分数都超过了标准.
总而言之:在9个基准中的5个基准的间隔中排除零、联系或3个基准中无定论的差别以及1个明确的HolUE胜(Yahoo Answers)。

blocks.en:
The Yahoo result is diagnostic.
Its error mass is almost purely false rejections of ambiguous multi-topic questions, for which the quality-driven KL 2 \mathrm{KL}_{2} feature under HolUE’s calibration is a near-ideal single signal.
MPRisk’s scalar objective gains FR sensitivity (FR AUROC 0.90 0.90 ) at the expense of FA sensitivity (FA AUROC 0.20 0.20 ).
Two remedies follow from our results: tune λ \lambda against the deployment’s own cost matrix, or use the hybrid, which recovers most of HolUE’s Yahoo performance while preserving MPRisk’s gains elsewhere.
blocks.zh:
雅虎结果为诊断.
其误差质量几乎是纯粹错误地拒绝模棱两可的多题问题,HolUE校准下质量驱动的KL 2\mathrm{KL}_{2}特征是一个近乎理想的单一信号.
MPRisk的平面目标增益了FR敏感度(FR AUROC 0.90 0.90 ),牺牲了FA敏感度(FA AUROC 0.20 0.20 ).
或使用混合体, 恢复大部分HolUE的雅虎性能,

blocks.en: The continuous unknown component contributes on three levels: small consistent PRR gains at specific operating points; a rejection-specific detection signal unavailable to a collapsed reject class; and an explanation of why a rejection is suspicious — high unknown mass with no specific unknown hypothesis — which single-scalar scores cannot articulate.
blocks.zh: 连续未知元件在三个层次上有所贡献:在特定操作点的微小一致PRR增益;一个崩溃的拒绝类无法找到的拒绝特定检测信号;以及解释为什么拒绝是可疑的——高未知质量,没有具体的未知假说——单分数无法说明.

blocks.en:
Logistic regression on the full 14 14 -dimensional feature set exceeds tuned MPRisk only modestly and not uniformly; the generic 14 14 -input MLP varies substantially across datasets, whereas HolUE’s two-input, task-objective MLP is stable.
On moderate validation sets, performance tracks how tightly the hypothesis class matches the task rather than raw capacity; MPRisk’s four-weight rule over semantically fixed components is the lowest-capacity option in this family and achieves comparable performance.
When abundant validation errors are available, the hybrid or a logistic detector on the joint features is a reasonable recipe; when validation data are limited, tuned MPRisk is a lower-risk choice and MPRisk raw a tuning-free fallback.
blocks.zh:
整个14 14 维特性集的逻辑回归只略微超过调制MPRisk;通用的14 14 输入 MLP在数据集上差异很大,而HolUE的双输入,任务目标 MLP是稳定的.
在中度验证集中,性能跟踪假设类与任务比比比比比比比生能力如何紧凑;MPRisk对组装固定组件的四重规则是这个家族中能力最低的选项,并实现可比较的性能.
当存在大量验证错误时,联合特性上的混合探测器或后勤探测器是一个合理的配方;当验证数据有限时,调制的MPRisk是一个风险较低的选择,MPRisk生一种无调制的回落.

blocks.en:
Tuned MPRisk depends on a validation split matched to the test operating point, and the scalar PRR objective induces error-type trade-offs (Section 5.9 ); multi-objective or cost-matrix tuning is a direct extension.
The method inherits the assumptions of the Bayesian posterior and the quality of the SCF embedding distribution: the mean-embedding approximation bounds posterior fidelity in extremely low- κ \kappa regimes, and the interpretation of non-specificity as evidence of false rejection has been validated only within the tested models.
Robustness under gallery shift and validation/test cost mismatch was not evaluated.
Finally, calibration results are mixed, and both methods over-predict error probability in the tails on text.
blocks.zh:
tuned MPRisk依赖于与测试操作点匹配的验证分解,而scalar PRR目标诱导出错误类型的权衡(第5.9节);多目标或成本矩阵调制是直接延伸.
该方法继承了贝叶斯语后缀的假设和SCF嵌入式分布的质量:在极低的\kappa制度中,中间-嵌入式近似约束后缀忠义,将非特定性解释为虚假拒绝的证据仅在被测试的模型中被验证.
未评价画廊转移和验证/测试成本不匹配的强度。
最后,校准结果褒贬不一,两种方法在文字上的尾部都存在超预误差概率.

blocks.en: 7 CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 7. 结 论

blocks.en:
We proposed MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score for uncertainty estimation in open-set recognition.
Instead of summarizing the gallery-aware Bayesian posterior by information gain and calibrating the result with a supervised nonlinear model, MPRisk directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision — false acceptance, misidentification, and false rejection — and adds a closed-form non-specificity penalty that flags confident but poorly supported rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component.
Four nonnegative validation-tuned weights suffice for ranking.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了MPRisk, 一种在开放式设定识别中不确定估计的先行决定风险分数。
MPRisk没有通过信息增益来总结画廊-意识的巴耶斯后期,用一个受监督的非线性模型来校准结果,而是直接对与所选决定相关的错误事件——虚假的接受,错误的识别,以及虚假的拒绝——进行评分,并增加了一种封闭式的非特殊性处罚,标出自信但支持不足的拒绝,通过将未知身份建模为连续组件而得以实现.
四个非负式验证调试权重足以进行排名.

blocks.en:
Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks under matched validation budgets, MPRisk is best or tied-best at all image and audio operating points and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks, at comparable or lower runtime.
Linear fusion of the KL features performs poorly, whereas the MPRisk components remain competitive with supervised error detectors; combining the two scores gives further gains in several settings.
These results suggest that decision-conditioned posterior risks provide a simple basis for selective OSR, while KL features supply complementary information when sufficient validation data are available.
Future work includes cost-matrix tuning of the weights and transferring decision-conditioned risk scoring to selective generation and hallucination detection in large language models [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
在匹配验证预算下的9个图像、音频和文本基准中,MPRisk在所有图像和音频操作点以及大多数文本操作点都是最佳或捆绑最佳的,在5个基准上,在可比或较低的运行时间上,靴子比HolUE得到肯定的收益。
KL 特性的线性聚变性表现不佳,而MPRisk 组件仍然与有监督的错误探测器有竞争力;将两个分数合并,在几个设置中可以进一步增益。
这些结果表明,有决定条件的后期风险为有选择的经营社会责任提供了简单的基础,而KL的特征是在获得足够的验证数据时提供补充信息。
今后的工作包括成本-矩阵调整权重,将决定条件的风险评分转移到大语言模型中的选择性生成和幻觉检测[35].
